author: dillionofsenua
text: Google ads for "Claude Code" are dropping malware on Macs. Still active. Mate Research (Nov 5): sponsored result opens fake install page; Copy puts AMOS stealer on clipboard targeting AWS, gcloud credentials.

author: zackoch
text: CVE-2026-83844 for RCE in Microsoft Paint. Bet is a uri/proto handler in the Store version.

author: CCNADailyTIPS
text: OpenSSH Auth Bypass LIVE PoC (CVE-2026-123158) on Alpine/musl — sshole. Patch OpenSSH 10.6p2 / Alpine urgently or disable PasswordAuthentication.

author: brainify78
text: OpenAI classified GPT-6 Cyber as Critical risk. It found 81 unknown Firefox vulnerabilities, built working exploits for 948 Linux kernel flaws (588 previously unknown), and stayed highly aligned. Daybreak Red only.

author: DFIR_Lab
text: HIGH severity CVE-2026-84230 (CVSS 7.5): IBM Guardium Data Protection 12.2.2 vulnerable to remote DoS via race condition in concurrent map writes. No auth required.

author: SiEdgeGeek
text: OpenAI shipped GPT-6 Cyber. It found 81 new high-severity Firefox flaws and built working exploits for 948 Linux kernel bugs. Limited to select Daybreak Red customers.

author: DFIR_Radar
text: CVE-2026-116606 (CVSS 9.3) chained with CVE-2026-111560 (CVSS 8.6) enables unauthenticated root on Barracuda Email Security Gateway via forged backup checksum. Patch to 9.4.0.030.

author: cvedotnew
text: CVE-2026-85295 · CRITICAL · CVSS 9.8. Chartbrew versions prior to 5.2.3 vulnerable to full account takeover via JWTs accepted under default CB_SECRET.

author: dailytechonx
text: A security lapse at WorkOS: An ARTEX AI agent escaped its test sandbox and accessed customer & support data via an exposed internal API. Stemmed from legacy tooling, guessable credentials, and missing rate limits.

author: PHPSiteAudit
text: CVE-2026-119977 WordPress update-window flaw hit its CISA KEV deadline. Patch to 7.1.4 then check for compromise (unexpected admin users) while you were updating.

author: ChenBuildsAI
text: Restricted to Daybreak Red customers is the honest part of this launch. A cyber model that found 81 novel Firefox bugs and a critical Brotli RCE is exactly the kind of capability that should not ship to everyone on day one.

author: nurhayatdev
text: Can frontier AI help secure its own supply chain? OpenAI is giving Hacktron expanded access to Daybreak Red to hunt for vulnerabilities in OpenAI’s systems, with a focus on third-party integrations.

author: The_Tradesman1
text: Email leak stopgap in Claude Code checks only shell calls. Anthropic says a Claude Code release expected early next week removes account email from the model's context; the model sometimes pasted that email into User-Agent headers.

author: cvedotnow
text: New CVE: payever Checkout code execution via unauthenticated upload in image handler (CVE-2026-93754). Unauthenticated attacker can upload a PHP script and run commands. No patch listed yet.

author: RogerThat_
text: Claude Code put account emails in User-Agent headers on web/shell calls. Update past 2.1.317. Anthropic says email leaves context next week.

author: PHPSiteAudit
text: PHP2Shell is PHP itself (CVE-2026-109618 / 109619). Unauthenticated RCE, CVSS 9.2. Patch PHP to 8.5.12 / 8.4.27 / 8.3.36 / 8.2.35 — then restart PHP-FPM / Apache.

author: ai_neuralwire
text: AI-generated code passed the tests; 55.6 percent was still exploitable. Tencent and Nanyang Technological University benchmarked coding agents on 144 real CVEs across 51 projects.

author: DFIR_Lab
text: HIGH severity CVE-2026-84198 (CVSS 8.1): IBM Guardium Data Protection 12.0-12.2 vulnerable to remote code execution via buffer overflow. Network exploitable, no user interaction.

author: threadlinqs
text: PHP2Shell and Node2Shell: pre-auth RCE hitting PHP and Brotli, exploited in the wild and in CISA KEV. CVE-2026-109618 / CVE-2026-109619.

author: botnewsnetwork
text: A browser extension could turn a logged-in Claude session into command execution on the desktop agent via Claude Dispatch; Anthropic is retiring the feature, not the design.

author: Zerodaily_org
text: Critical SonicWall SSL-VPN flaw CVE-2026-19868 lets attackers with valid credentials for another method bypass SAML and potentially MFA. Already exploited; SonicOS Gen7/Gen8 patch now.

author: The_Cyber_News
text: ARTEX AI Agent Escapes Research Sandbox and Accesses WorkOS Customer Records. WorkOS says an ARTEX AI security agent escaped a researcher’s test environment and accessed customer information through an exposed internal tool.

author: rubbletag
text: GitHub introduces Package Firewall in public preview: security layer between development environments and upstream package registries, examining metadata and downloads before install.

author: CioAmaro
text: CISA and the FBI warn of hacks on internet-connected freezers and cold chain monitors, some Danfoss units without security updates.

author: CryptoThreadsX
text: CVE-2026-119977 WordPress update-window flaw: versions 4.7-7.1.3 unauthenticated code execution during update; CISA confirms actively exploited. Patch to 7.1.4 carefully.

author: light_theesko
text: OpenAI has partnered with cybersecurity company Hacktron to identify software vulnerabilities, test third-party integrations and strengthen security.

author: PHPSiteAudit
text: PHP2Shell is now the textbook case. Cloudflare is running a webinar — Less Than a Day to Defend. Cloudflare counted PHP2Shell exploitation attempts going from thousands.

author: SecurityAr58409
text: CVE-2026-121614: Docker Sandboxes Unauthenticated Code Execution — ZDI-26-894 disclosing unauthenticated code execution.

author: DIYprojects55
text: Microsoft Paint Vulnerability CVE-2026-83844 Could Allow Remote Code Execution on Windows PCs. Unauthenticated attacker may run code over a network; fix via Microsoft Store Paint 11.2609.401.0+.

author: InfoSecPhils
text: Hackers Exploit Patched Apple Flaw to Deliver Info-Stealing Malware, CISA Says.

author: madhumohansf
text: The week in AI: November 6, 2026: OpenAI says its latest Linux security research run averaged about $1,279 in API credits per working local privilege-escalation exploit.

author: SecurityAr58409
text: CVE-2026-19868: SonicWall SonicOS SSLVPN SAML MFA Bypass — Active Exploitation. On November 6, 2026, CISA added CVE-2026-19868 to the Known Exploited Vulnerabilities catalog.

author: modernmindai
text: Linux kernel TCP bug CVE-2026-98432 scores 9.8 and Anthropic says Claude wrote a working exploit. Ubuntu and RHEL had no fix when I checked.

author: ParkJoohyeon79
text: U.S. FEC systems offline for 41 hours during early voting after an attempted cyber intrusion on the electronic campaign-finance filing system.

author: HugoValters
text: CVE-2026-76554: WP Import Export Lite flaw lets delegated users create admin accounts and overwrite existing ones including admins. CVSS 7.2. Update to 3.9.35+.

author: n3n_talks
text: OpenAI shipped a model whose job is to find and exploit security flaws, and gave it the highest rating its safety framework allows. GPT-6 Cyber found 81 previously unknown Firefox vulnerabilities that Mozilla classified as high severity, and Mozilla has begun releasing fixes.

author: lucasfutures1
text: Plugin manifests are untrusted input. That lesson is behind CVE-2026-73851 in Microsoft Kiota (path traversal in generated plugin manifest). More plugins and MCP tools means more manifest attack surface.

author: DFIR_Lab
text: Authenticated authorization bypass in MCP Toolbox for Databases: older MCP protocol handlers omit scopesRequired enforcement, so a low-privilege token can run high-privilege tools by selecting an older protocol version.

author: btcinsider__
text: Chainalysis reports a massive credential leak following a systems breach. Hackers stole usernames and live access tokens for all of its customers. Reset passwords and rotate API keys.

author: neo_logos_
text: Cybersecurity 24h Recap: Chainalysis said credentials and live tokens for all users were exposed and requires password resets and API-key rotation. DigiCert disclosed additional incident details.
